papers.title_en: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Qianzhong Chen, Muyuan Lin, Yuyin Sun, Mac Schwager, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.evidence: 面向全身人形机器人移动操作的世界模型闭环强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA的强化学习后训练面临真实探索不安全、仿真RL又会利用sim-to-real残差的问题。WEVO提出免遥操作框架，在动作条件视频世界模型中后训练全身人形VLA：先用仿真操作与运动play数据增强接触动力学和视角变化预测，再用每任务20条自主真实rollout对齐世界模型。VLA、全身控制器与视频WM组成带稠密进度奖励的闭环RL环境。三个真实任务上，视频WM RL把平均成功率从23.3%提到75.0%，高于真实机器人RL的48.3%。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ganeshvar Soenessardien, Michael Przystupa, Kevin Sebastian Luck
papers.evidence: 无需示教的人形机器人滑板运动深度强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人行走跑步进展快，但与被动外部物体协同的物体介导运动仍很难，滑板需同时与地面和可动板交互。本文提出无参考数据的无模型深度强化学习框架，将任务奖励与阻断取巧的终止条件结合，让K1人形机器人自主学习滑板。训练中逐步调整脚不离板、禁止双脚站板、限制扭转、防止离板与板体不稳等约束的权重/出现频率，形成从站姿控制到持续人板运动的隐式课程。该方法无需人类演示或解析转向模型与系统辨识，为物体介导的人形运动提供了可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. The method combines task rewards with exploit-blocking terminations. We introduce a number of constraints restricting behaviours such as losing the planted board foot, standing with both feet on the board, excessive twisting, separation from the board, and unstable board motion. Their changing prevalence during training produces an implicit progression from stance control towards sustained robot--board locomotion.

papers.title_en: SGPC: Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint for Stable Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yifan Liu, Nan Zhang, Yang Cong
papers.evidence: 带安全策略约束的约束优化安全强化学习
papers.tldr: 离线策略安全强化学习需在任务最优性与约束可行性间权衡，原始-对偶方法因自适应拉格朗日乘子耦合优化，易在安全边界附近产生策略振荡并放大不可靠奖励估计。本文引入安全引导策略SGP及对应约束SGPC，构造带条件性安全引导约束的新约束优化问题。若当前actor被成本critic预测越出安全集，则由SGP提供低成本参考并引导优化，进入安全集后该约束失效。实验表明该方法显著降低约束违反与成本振荡，同时保持或提升任务回报。
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy safe reinforcement learning (RL) faces a challenging trade-off between task optimality and constraint feasibility. In primal-dual methods, the coupled optimization of cumulative reward and constraint penalties through adaptive Lagrange multipliers may induce oscillatory policy updates near the safety boundary and amplify the effect of unreliable reward estimates outside the safe set. To address these issues, we formulate a new constrained optimization problem (COP) for safe RL by introducing a Safety-Guiding Policy (SGP) and a corresponding Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC). The proposed COP augments the standard COP in safe RL with a conditional safety-guidance constraint. During actor updates, the current actor is evaluated using the learned cost critic. If it is predicted to be outside the safe set, SGP provides a nearby lower-cost training reference, and SGPC guides actor optimization toward this reference. Once the policy enters the safe set, the added constraint becomes inactive, and the formulation reduces to the original COP. This formulation leads to a plug-in actor-training constraint that can be integrated into off-policy safe RL algorithms. By applying primal-dual optimization to the auxiliary COP, we finally derive an SGPC-based off-policy safe RL algorithm and implement it in two representative off-policy algorithms, yielding SAC-SGPC and TD3-SGPC. Experiments on multiple Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks demonstrate that SGPC achieves a better optimality-safety trade-off by substantially reducing constraint violations and cost oscillations while maintaining competitive or better task returns.

papers.title_en: Learning Linear Time-Varying Koopman Models for Constrained Nonlinear Optimal Control
papers.authors: Zhi Xu, Ran Dai
papers.evidence: 用于约束非线性最优控制的学习型Koopman表示
papers.tldr: 针对受控非线性动力学与约束下最优控制难以兼顾表达力和计算效率的问题，本文构建线性时变Koopman表示，并分析建模误差在长预测时域中的传播。进一步提出神经网络Koopman框架，联合学习提升动力学与约束表示，并加入稳定性正则化。基于该模型将原约束非线性最优控制转化为带保守约束收紧的凸二次规划。低推力轨道转移与火星进入制导算例验证了预测精度、求解效率和约束控制性能。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a learning-based Koopman framework for solving constrained nonlinear optimal control problems. Despite significant advances in Koopman-based modeling and control, challenges remain in achieving accurate representations of controlled nonlinear dynamics and constraints while maintaining computational efficiency for optimal control. Motivated by these challenges, a linear time-varying (LTV) Koopman representation is developed to provide a more expressive representation of controlled nonlinear dynamics while preserving a linear prediction structure suitable for efficient convex optimization. Modeling errors and their propagation over extended prediction horizons are analyzed, motivating a neural-network-based Koopman framework that jointly learns lifted dynamics and constraint representations with stability-oriented regularization to improve long-horizon prediction performance. Based on the learned Koopman model, the original constrained nonlinear optimal control problem is reformulated as a convex quadratic program with conservative constraint tightening to account for modeling uncertainty during constraint enforcement. Numerical results on a low-thrust orbit transfer problem and a Mars entry guidance problem demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in terms of prediction accuracy, computational efficiency, and constrained optimal control performance.

papers.title_en: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.authors: Ting-Hsuan Chen, Siheng Zhao, Han Jiang, Qi Pan, Louison Lu, Jiaheng Luo, Henghui Bao, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 去中心化多机器人全身运动操作控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人协作需全身协调、长程规划与跨机同步，现有方法难以兼顾。Heave-Ho提出去中心化长程多机人形移动操作框架：低层用多智能体后训练适配物理耦合，高层训练视觉语言规划器并以语音领从机制同步执行。仅用两台相同人形训练，系统可扩展至十机团队并泛化到异构团队。团队构建HH-Bench含12项2-10机任务，实验显示持续优于基线，并在真实任务中实现无网络通信的鲁棒协作。
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

papers.title_en: ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
papers.authors: Katarzyna Fojcik, Aidas Mikalauskas, Matthias Kampa, Renaldas Zioma, Jogundas Armaitis
papers.evidence: 在保留残差流的前提下将残差网络蒸馏为查找表网络
papers.tldr: 逻辑网络虽适合硬件推理，但深层训练与连接学习困难。ResoLUT将已训练ResNet逐层蒸馏为LUT树，保留多比特残差流与BatchNorm，并用硬LUT决策贯穿训练推理。ResoLUT-20在CIFAR-10达95.66%，ResoLUT-56在CIFAR-100达78.87%，ImageNet 64px达53.69%，刷新LUT网络最佳。优化版ResoLUT-8以1/8树预算在FPGA上达90.04%和189k图像/秒，证明深度可扩展且吞吐高。
papers.abstract_en: Logic networks built from Boolean gates or lookup tables (LUTs) promise efficient hardware inference, but training them at depth and learning their connectivity remain difficult. We do not train logic as logic. Instead, ResoLUT distills a trained residual network (ResNet) layer by layer into LUT trees, preserving its multi-bit residual stream and BatchNorm while extracting connectivity from the teacher rather than learning it. To our knowledge, ResoLUT is the first convolutional logic network in computer vision to retain a ResNet-style multi-bit residual stream. Hard LUT decisions are used throughout training and inference, avoiding a discretization gap in the logic. ResoLUT-20 reaches 95.66% on CIFAR-10 with twice the trees, and ResoLUT-56 reaches 78.87% on CIFAR-100 and 53.69% on ImageNet at 64px, the best results of logic and lookup-table networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, showing that LUT networks can scale in depth. We explore and quantify the role of the residuals and the tree budget and shape. The most optimized model, a ResoLUT-8 with one eighth of the trees and further optimizations, fits on an FPGA and reaches 90.04% at 189k images per second, the highest throughput among the compared models above 85% on CIFAR-10.

papers.title_en: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
papers.authors: Malak Gamal El-Din, Yasser Shoukry, Salma Elmalaki
papers.evidence: 面向紧凑Bernstein激活卷积网络的硬件感知神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 资源受限微控制器上的时间序列神经网络受压缩精度损失与无乘法权重表示制约。BeFit把容量转移到可学习Bernstein多项式激活，结合硬件感知NAS、知识蒸馏、权重投影和专用卷积核。同架构BeCNN在人体活动识别平均高2.75个百分点；CC3220SF投影提速2.2倍仅损0.8个百分点；相对MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN，投影模型快5.9倍，RISC-V无乘法器上指令数降低达147倍。为资源受限感知提供精度与效率兼顾的新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations. BeFit (i) finds compact Bernstein-activated convolutional neural networks (BeCNNs) through hardware-aware neural architecture search and trains them via knowledge distillation; (ii) projects their weights to multiplication-free codes, freezes the codes, and recovers the resulting accuracy loss through the learnable activations; and (iii) generates model-specific kernels that exploit the projected weights for multiplication-free convolutions. On human activity recognition, BeCNNs are 2.75 percentage points (pp) more accurate on average than ReLU CNNs of identical architecture. On a TI CC3220SF (Cortex-M4), weight projection speeds BeCNNs up by 2.2x on average while losing 0.8 pp, compared with 2.4 pp for ReLU CNNs. Against the MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN reference model running on TensorFlow Lite Micro with CMSIS-NN, the unprojected BeCNN achieves 1.0 pp higher accuracy, 2.2x lower latency, and 6.4x lower flash, while the projected model remains within 1.0 pp of the reference accuracy and runs 5.9x faster. In emulation on a RISC-V core without a hardware multiplier, the instruction-count reduction relative to the DS-CNN increases from 5.2x on the Cortex-M4 to 147x. BeFit also extends to transformers and MLPs, and across all tasks the final models stay within 1.56 pp of their float32 teachers on average.

papers.title_en: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
papers.authors: EngineAI
papers.evidence: 全身人体运动数据与人形机器人移动操作运动模型
papers.tldr: 现有自我中心视频缺乏同步全身运动数据，限制人形机器人大规模学习移动操作。作者构建约5万小时、100+技能的Awaken-Human数据集，并提出共享动作专家的VLA模型Awaken-HI，联合预测人体运动与重定向机器人动作。人体轨迹直接监督共享专家可提升迁移，并呈现数据缩放规律。全量预训练与T800适配后在8项任务达93.75%成功率，优于GR00T N1.7和π0.5，并具备新物体与组合泛化。
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

papers.title_en: Convex Structure-Preserving EDMD: Passive Koopman Matrices as $Q$-Contractions
papers.authors: Matthias Ehrhardt, Achraf Zinihi
papers.evidence: 面向无源Koopman矩阵的凸结构保持EDMD
papers.tldr: 端口哈密顿系统的EDMD最小二乘矩阵常破坏无源性和守恒量。本文对提升pH模型作隐式中点离散，证明所得Koopman矩阵是(J-R)Q的Cayley变换，属于Q收缩闭包且可由LMI表示，从而把含端口与Casimir约束的结构保持EDMD写成半定规划。约束估计是数据加权投影，理论上误差界随时间线性增长；实验表明约束模型不产能量并保持Casimir至约1e-8，但以物理能量为Q时精度低于EDMD且存在结构偏差。
papers.abstract_en: Extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) approximates the Koopman operator using a matrix based on a finite set of observables. However, the least-squares matrix of a port-Hamiltonian (pH) system is generally neither passive nor invariant-preserving. We demonstrate that the implicit midpoint discretization of a lifted pH model precisely preserves energy balance, passivity, and all linear Casimirs for every step size. For a fixed storage metric $Q$, the resulting Koopman matrices are the Cayley transforms of $(J-R)Q$, where $J$ is skew-symmetric and $R$ is positive semidefinite. This set does not depend on the step size and is the closure of all Q-contractions. This set is LMI-representable; therefore, structure-preserving EDMD, including ports through a discrete-time Kalman-Yakubovich-Popov condition and Casimirs through affine constraints, is a semidefinite program. The constrained estimate is a projection of the unconstrained estimate in the data-weighted norm and cannot increase estimation error when the population target is pH-compatible. For every $Q$-contraction, a certified bound on the lifted prediction error grows linearly at most in time, whereas it grows geometrically for unconstrained models with Q-gain above one. Benchmarks on a damped pendulum and a damped rigid body demonstrate that constrained models never generate energy and that imposed Casimirs are maintained with solver accuracy (approximately $10^{-8}$). In contrast, EDMD may diverge or lose the Casimir with noisy data. The benchmarks also demonstrate that when $Q$ is the physical energy, the constrained models are less accurate than EDMD and can exhibit significant structural bias.

papers.title_en: Cone-Constrained Safe Policy Learning With Finite-Step Improvement Guarantees
papers.authors: Liangliang Hao, Wei Liu, Yunjian Xu
papers.evidence: 带可学长时风险表示与约束策略优化的安全强化学习
papers.tldr: 安全强化学习需在提升任务表现的同时降低长期约束导致的不可行风险，而长时风险难以表示和优化。本文提出可学习的约束聚合函数CAF刻画折扣长时风险，并据此构建风险优势与锥约束策略优化CCPO，通过梯度投影在安全锥内协调任务上升与风险下降。理论上在平滑性与步长界下保证有限步内任务改进和风险降低；紧急制动实验中保持可行且平均最优性差距1.05%，安全关键基准约束违反低。
papers.abstract_en: One central challenge in safe reinforcement learning is improving task performance while reducing infeasibility risk, especially when long-term constraint consequences are difficult to represent and optimize. We propose the Constraint Aggregation Function (CAF), a learnable feasibility-oriented representation of long-horizon risk that satisfies a discounted Bellman recursion and admits a unique fixed point. The proposed CAF induces a risk advantage that measures the reduction in predicted unsafety relative to the current policy. Building on this representation, we develop Cone-Constrained Policy Optimization (CCPO), which uses the CAF-induced risk advantage to define a risk descent direction. The proposed CCPO resolves conflicts between task ascent and risk descent through gradient projection, selecting the final update from the relative interior of a constructed safety cone. Under standard smoothness assumptions and a step-size bound, this update guarantees simultaneous task improvement and risk reduction. Numerically, CCPO stays feasible with a 1.05% mean optimality gap in emergency braking and attains low constraint violations on safety-critical benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
papers.authors: Josef Brozovich, Qining Zhang, Lei Ying
papers.evidence: 用学习式预测器替代自动机在强化学习中强制执行时序安全规范
papers.tldr: 强化学习中的时序安全约束通常需要把逻辑公式转换为自动机来做状态增强和奖励塑形，但自动机构造的可处理性限制了其适用范围。本文提出 Actor-Predictor 框架，不显式构造自动机，而是学习一个预测器来估计部分轨迹未来能否满足形式规范，并将其学到的特征作为 actor 的辅助输入，用 GRPO 和 RWR 优化策略。理论分析表明，在预测足够准确时，该表示等价于自动机状态。在网格世界和 Isaac Lab 机器人任务上，该方法在 LTL 约束任务上优于基于自动机的基线，并能处理 $(a^n b^n)$ 等非正则规范。
papers.abstract_en: One fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is enforcing temporal safety constraints, such as satisfying formal specifications. Existing methods often transform logic formulas into automata for state augmentation and reward shaping. However, this approach assumes that automaton construction is both feasible and tractable, which limits its applicability to small specifications and linear temporal logic (LTL). This paper proposes Actor-Predictor, a framework that learns a surrogate representation of logic progress without explicitly constructing an automaton. The predictor continuously estimates whether a partial trajectory will satisfy the formal specification in a later step, and its learned features are provided as auxiliary inputs to the actor, which is then optimized using GRPO and RWR. We show theoretically that, under sufficient predictive accuracy, the learned representation is equivalent to the automaton state. Experiments on grid world and robotic tasks in Isaac Lab demonstrate that Actor-Predictor outperforms automaton-based baselines on LTL-constrained tasks. It also performs well on non-regular formal specifications, such as $(a^n b^n)$, for which finite-automaton-based approaches are not applicable.

papers.title_en: Latent Jacobian Steer: Eliciting Contact-Rich Out-of-Distribution Behaviors from Pretrained Humanoid Controllers
papers.authors: S K Swaminathan, Shivam Sood, Shreyansh Kansal, Chengyang He, Guillaume Adrien Sartoretti
papers.evidence: 引导预训练人形机器人全身控制器产生富接触行为
papers.tldr: 预训练潜条件人形控制器虽具通用全身协调，却难以诱导分布外接触丰富行为：关节动作探索易破坏协调，潜空间探索又难导向目标物理效果。LJS将任务相关关节动作扰动经策略雅可比阻尼逆映射为候选潜命令，交由冻结策略执行并在仿真中搜索组合。在跨栏、铰接物体操作、非抓握开门及灵巧手装配任务上，LJS优于单独动作、潜或目标空间搜索。该工作表明耦合动作与潜空间可保留预训练协调并有效激发OOD行为。
papers.abstract_en: Given a pretrained general latent-conditioned whole-body humanoid controller, say a behavioral foundation model (BFM), how can we elicit complex and contact-rich out-of-distribution behaviors? Raw joint-action exploration enables direct, task-specific adjustments but can disrupt coordination learned by the pretrained controller, whereas latent exploration retains that coordination but is difficult to steer toward desired physical effects. To combine the complementary strengths of these exploration spaces, we propose Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS), which couples sampling in direct joint-action space with the semantics of the learned frozen controller's input latent space. For a task specified through desired physical effects, we sample task-relevant joint-action perturbations and map them through a damped local inverse of the policy Jacobian to obtain candidate latent ($z$) commands. These commands are executed through the frozen pretrained policy, while exploration is directed toward the physical outcomes required by the new task. Candidate outcomes are evaluated in simulation and composed into latent-command sequences that accomplish the task. Ablations show that neither action-space nor latent-space exploration alone provides the same capability as their coupling. Across diverse out-of-distribution tasks, simulation-based searching using this method produces contact-rich behaviors, including hurdling, manipulating articulated objects, and opening doors through non-prehensile contact. Over ten seeds, LJS completes more of each humanoid task than when searching in either space alone. Beyond humanoids, it also steers a goal-conditioned dexterous hand policy through four assembly tasks better than searching in goal space directly.

papers.title_en: S-BFM: A Behavioral Foundation Model for Humanoid Control from Sparse Spatiotemporal Goals
papers.authors: Kun Yang, Xuanyu Chen, Jing Tan, Yanjing Liu, Yubo Zhao, Renjing Xu, Addison Lin Wang
papers.evidence: 从稀疏目标生成人形全身运动的行为基础模型
papers.tldr: 人形全身跟踪器依赖密集参考轨迹，而任务往往只给出到达位置、姿态与时间，中间运动需另做规划。S-BFM 从稀疏时空目标自主生成全身过渡：用空间接地加入世界坐标位置与朝向，以时间条件蒸馏学习节奏，再用生成式微调扩展距离与到达时间。仿真中全局关节位置误差较最佳基线降低超32%，固定目标到达率由43.5%升至74.6%，终点误差从1.67米降至0.26米。该工作让稀疏时空目标足以驱动机器人自然且合时的全身运动。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose whole-body trackers can execute diverse humanoid motions, but they require dense reference trajectories. However, tasks usually specify only where, in which posture, and when the robot should arrive, leaving the motion in between to a separate planner. Inspired by human motor coordination, our key idea is that a low-level controller can organize the intervening motion and its pace by itself from sparse goals with arrival times. In this paper, we propose S-BFM, a novel behavioral foundation model superior in its autonomy: it generates whole-body transitions from target postures, poses, and arrival times alone. Specifically, we first introduce Spatial Grounding, which adds world-frame position and heading to a forward-backward behavior representation through spatial reconstruction. Then, Time-Conditioned Distillation is designed to learn transitions and pace from real motion through closed-loop imitation of a dense-reference teacher. Lastly, Generative Fine-Tuning is introduced to broaden the covered distances and arrival times with a distilled motion generator. In simulation, S-BFM lowers global joint-position error by over 32% relative to the best baseline under fixed and mixed horizons, and raises fixed-goal reach from 43.5% to 74.6% while cutting terminal position error from 1.67 to 0.26 m. We further deploy S-BFM on the full-size AGIBOT A3 humanoid. Sparse spatiotemporal goals thus suffice for natural, well-timed whole-body motion.

papers.title_en: Humanoid robots for safety-critical electrical switching: A perception-informed runtime constraint filter
papers.authors: Songyang Liu, Yu Hou, Yuqing Hu, Shuai Li
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人控制的控制障碍函数二次规划安全滤波
papers.tldr: 在电气倒闸作业中，人形机器人可降低人员暴露风险，但工具接近目标开关时容易误触相邻同类开关，安全控制困难。本文提出运行时安全滤波器，融合头部相机场景估计与目标条件控制屏障函数二次规划，在VR遥操作中逐条校验指令并保持安全指令不变。Unitree G1实机两站位各六轮、共十轮目标操作全部成功且无误触，仿真安全完成9/9，优于原始遥操作的5/9。结果表明该方法可提升人形机器人电气倒闸操作的安全性。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots can reduce personnel exposure in electrical switching, but safe control is challenging because the tool must reach a target switch next to similar devices, where an imprecise operator command can contact a non-target switch. This study proposes a runtime safety filter that checks each operator command during virtual-reality teleoperation of a humanoid robot. The filter integrates a scene model estimated from the robot head camera and a target-conditioned control barrier function quadratic program that keeps the tool away from the non-target switch while passing safe commands unchanged. In real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, with six rounds at each of two standing positions, target operations succeed in all ten rounds with an unchanged target and no non-target actuation. A simulation study achieves 9/9 safe completions, compared with 5/9 for raw teleoperation, demonstrating the feasibility of the method for humanoid switching operations.

papers.title_en: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
papers.authors: Yuhan Wang, Ruiyang Wang, Jiaguan Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向流式VLA策略后训练的结果均衡PPO
papers.tldr: 面向基于流的VLA策略，强化学习后训练虽能提升任务回报，却会破坏随机转移所依赖的速度场几何，并在稀疏多任务采样下造成任务与优势符号间学习信号不均。为此，论文提出Outcome-Balanced PPO，按任务成功率重加权正优势并保持符号重缩放正负优势，同时周期性地用当前策略生成的ODE端点对拟合线性桥流，进行策略诱导的流校正。在仿真操作基准上，该方法相较对比基线提升了成功率，并在Real2Sim2Real任务中考察了优化行为与流一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Sim2CBF: From Forward Simulations to Implicit Control Barrier Function Safety Filtering without Model Derivatives
papers.authors: Luzia Knoedler, Yihan Liu, Shaohang Han, Yifei Dong, Jana Tumova
papers.evidence: 无需模型导数的控制屏障函数安全滤波，实现硬安全约束
papers.tldr: 复杂机器人交互中动力学难精确建模，预测模型导数常不可靠，使避障安全滤波受限。Sim2CBF仅用前向模型评估求解CBF安全滤波优化，通过有限差分与采样控制上的局部线性插值近似约束，并用备份策略rollout构造隐式CBF。相比纯采样滤波所需控制样本更少，较直接名义-备份混合更不保守。在仿真、硬件翻箱和视觉控制任务中验证了对接触丰富、学习动力学及预测模型变化的适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Failure avoidance in complex robot-environment interactions is challenging because the underlying dynamics are difficult to model accurately, and available predictive models may not provide reliable derivatives. We present Sim2CBF, a failure-avoidance framework that solves the Control Barrier Function (CBF)-Safety Filter (SF) optimization problem using only forward-model evaluations, thereby avoiding differentiation of the predictive model. Specifically, we approximate the CBF constraint using finite differences and local linear interpolation over sampled control inputs while preserving failure-avoidance guarantees. The underlying CBF is implicit and constructed from backup-policy rollouts, enabling the use of expressive predictive models such as physics-based simulators and learned world models. Compared with purely sampling-based SFs, our formulation requires fewer control samples and yields less conservative behavior than direct nominal-backup blending. We evaluate Sim2CBF in simulation, hardware box-toppling, and vision-based control tasks, demonstrating its applicability to contact-rich and learned dynamics, as well as its adaptability to changes in the predictive model.

papers.title_en: Stability analysis of stochastic differential equations with the Koopman operator
papers.authors: François-Grégoire Bierwart, Gaëtan Louvet, Alexandre Mauroy
papers.evidence: Koopman算子框架下的随机动力系统稳定性分析
papers.tldr: 随机微分方程的稳定性分析通常面临噪声与非线性耦合的困难，本文采用Koopman算子框架研究随机系统的稳定性。作者建立Koopman半群收敛性质与随机系统稳定性之间的对应关系，并说明特定Koopman特征函数能够刻画随机吸引性。随后通过两个数值例子展示上述理论结果的有效性。该工作将确定性系统已有的Koopman稳定性结论推广至随机情形，为随机稳定性分析提供了算子半群视角。
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the stability of stochastic systems through the lens of the Koopman operator framework. In particular, we establish the connection between the convergence properties of the Koopman semigroup and specific stability properties of the underlying stochastic system. Moreover, we demonstrate that specific Koopman eigenfunctions capture stochastic attractivity properties and we illustrate these results with two numerical examples. This work mirrors existing Koopman operator-based stability results for deterministic systems and extends them to the stochastic framework.

papers.title_en: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
papers.authors: Rafael Mouallem Rosa, Julyan Arbel
papers.evidence: 用贝叶斯结构化稀疏从过参数化模型恢复紧凑CNN架构
papers.tldr: 针对高度参数化CNN部署成本高的问题，提出SoU-RHS贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法，将RHS与SoU-SGL全局-局部机制结合，以强化活跃/非活跃滤波器分离并恢复紧凑架构。该方法在不同过参数化初始宽度和阈值下保持稳定，层间分配与总规模相近。图像分类基准上，它比确定性结构化稀疏基线得到更小架构，同时保持竞争性精度、更低NLL且通常更低ECE。
papers.abstract_en: Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. Across standard image-classification benchmarks, SoU-RHS recovers substantially smaller architectures than deterministic structured-sparsity baselines, while maintaining competitive accuracy, achieving lower negative log-likelihood in every evaluated configuration and generally lower expected calibration error.

papers.title_en: Conditional Mean-Field Type Linear Quadratic Optimal Control Problem for Regime-Switching Diffusions with Indefinite Coefficients
papers.authors: Zhongbin Guo, Guangchen Wang, Shupeng Wang
papers.evidence: 基于耦合Riccati方程的线性二次最优控制理论
papers.tldr: 本文研究系数不定且状态与控制的条件期望进入动态和成本的机制切换扩散线性二次最优控制。作者在标准正定条件下用两组耦合Riccati方程和马尔可夫链驱动的线性倒向随机微分方程刻画最优控制与最优成本。针对不定权重，提出基于状态条件均值及其偏差的机制依赖二次调整的等价成本泛函方法。由此获得原Hamiltonian系统唯一可解与反馈最优控制，并用于条件均值-方差投资组合选择。
papers.abstract_en: We study a conditional mean-field type linear quadratic optimal control problem for regime-switching diffusions with indefinite weights. The dynamics and cost depend on conditional expectations of the state and control given the history of the Markov chain. Under standard definiteness conditions, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the optimal control and derive its feedback representation and optimal cost through two sets of coupled Riccati equations and a linear backward stochastic differential equation driven by the Markov chain. To treat the case of indefinite weights, we extend the equivalent cost functional approach to this setting using regime-dependent quadratic adjustments for the conditional mean of the state and its deviation from that mean. When the transformed weights in the equivalent cost functional satisfy standard definiteness conditions, this construction yields unique solvability of the original Hamiltonian system and a feedback representation of the unique optimal control. The proposed results also provide an effective method for establishing the solvability of fully coupled linear conditional mean-field forward-backward stochastic differential equations that do not satisfy certain existing monotonicity conditions. We further apply the results to conditional mean-variance portfolio selection with exogenous liability in an incomplete regime-switching market and derive the optimal investment strategy.

papers.title_en: Towards Optimism-Pessimism Trade-off in Model-based Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Guochen Zhou, Yijun Yang, Qiqi Duan, Qing Su, Weiming Ou, Li Shen, Shihao Ji, Yuhui Shi, Zhisong Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于模型的离线到在线强化学习的乐观悲观权衡
papers.tldr: 模型型离线到在线强化学习常因两阶段分布偏移而难以微调，且乐观—悲观权衡多被压缩为单目标，系数选择依赖昂贵的双层优化。本文将其建模为双目标问题，离线训练生成Pareto策略池，并在线用上下文老虎机分层选择合适策略微调。所提HiP3在同任务与新任务上取得最强综合表现，并在更强分布偏移下保持优势。该工作为离线到在线RL的自适应权衡提供了可复用框架。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) enables sample-efficient adaptation by leveraging offline pre-training for online fine-tuning. However, the distribution shifts between offline and online stages often hinder fine-tuning performance. Many existing methods encode the optimism-pessimism trade-off through a single-objective formulation. Selecting its trade-off coefficient through online fine-tuning can require costly bi-level optimization. We identify the balance established during offline training as a key challenge: in our motivating experiments, optimistic policies adapt better to novel tasks, whereas pessimistic policies perform better on the same online tasks. To address this challenge, we propose a bi-objective formulation that captures this trade-off, yielding a Pareto policy pool during offline training. This policy pool enables adaptive selection during online fine-tuning across diverse online tasks. To generate the pool, we introduce Multi-Objective Soft Actor-critIC (MOSAIC), which solves bi-objective problems and constructs diverse Pareto policies. After offline training, a contextual bandit algorithm hierarchically selects the most suitable policy for fine-tuning at each online interaction step. Empirically, our pipeline, Hierarchical Pareto Policy Pool (HiP3), achieves the strongest aggregate performance across both same and novel online tasks and maintains its advantage under stronger distribution shifts. Comprehensive ablations further clarify the roles of the policy pool, MOSAIC-based pool construction, and the online selection mechanism.

papers.title_en: JEPA Dots: Dual-Latent World Model for Language-Guided Robot Control
papers.authors: Xianhao Pan, Chi Li, Hanchao Li, Yunxin Liu, Jiankai Sun, Luhui Hu
papers.evidence: 用于语言引导机器人控制的双潜在预测世界模型
papers.tldr: 语言引导机器人控制需让指令影响动作，又不改变固定观测与动作下的预测结果。JEPA Dots 用分离的动态与任务双潜表示，语言特征驱动流匹配策略，掩码注意力限制世界预测仅依赖与指令无关的动态历史及给定动作。在40个LIBERO任务上取得84.9%成功率、约39.1M参数；参考实验中较任务ID基线76.0%提升至84.9%，LIBERO-Goal由67.1%升至88.5%。指令切换验证任务表示随语言变化，而动态表示与世界预测保持稳定。
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models for language-guided robot control face a fundamental conditioning challenge: instructions should influence action selection without altering the predicted consequences of fixed actions under identical observations. To address this challenge, we introduce JEPA Dots (Dynamics-Oriented Task Separation), a compact dual-latent framework that jointly learns visual dynamics and language-guided control through separate dynamics and task representations. Language-conditioned task features guide a flow-matching policy, while masked attention restricts world prediction to instruction-independent dynamics history and supplied actions. In closed-loop evaluation on 40 trained LIBERO tasks, JEPA Dots achieves 84.9% overall success with approximately 39.1M parameters, compared with the published 78.7% of NanoVLA-S with 161.0M parameters under a different evaluation protocol. In the reference experiment, JEPA Dots also improves overall success from 76.0% for our task-ID-conditioned adaptation baseline to 84.9%, with LIBERO-Goal success increasing from 67.1% to 88.5%. Instruction-switching experiments further confirm that task representations and policy outputs respond to language changes, while dynamics representations and world predictions remain invariant under fixed observations and supplied actions.

papers.title_en: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
papers.authors: Yeachan Park, Yeoneung Kim
papers.evidence: 强制凸性结构的输入凸神经网络架构
papers.tldr: 输入凸神经网络能以架构约束全局保证凸性，但如何扩展到半凸、拟凸及可凸变换函数仍缺乏统一逼近理论。本文用max-affine分段、二次提升与单调复合建立保持结构的逼近框架，并针对Lipschitz拟凸函数提出有限探针逼近与IqCNN。理论给出C^{1,1}凸函数的W^{1,p}极小极大速率m^{-1/d}及线性复杂度精确ICNN表示，并获得L∞保证。实验在PDE逼近中无需调形状惩罚即保持全局结构且精度有竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and validation-tuned shape penalties, demonstrating global structural validity without penalty tuning while maintaining competitive approximation accuracy. Overall, the results identify recoverable convex latent structure as the key mechanism enabling gradient-level structure-preserving approximation beyond convexity.

papers.title_en: Broximal Gradient Descent in General Norms: Convergence without Fejér Monotonicity
papers.authors: Peter Richtárik, Xun Qian
papers.evidence: 带收敛性保证的凸约束优化求解算法
papers.tldr: 一般范数下闭凸集光滑优化的 Broximal 梯度下降可能非 Fejér 单调，到解距离会上升。论文用比较器不等式与可观测平稳性证书分析，并分离局部 oracle 与水平集、半径校准控制。凸目标获预设半径值收敛、未达下确界逃逸、无距离界假设的末迭代 O(K^(-1/3))，水平集界下全迭代 O(1/K) 及渐近 O(log K/K)。强凸与幂增长给出更快包络，非凸约束 PL 下线性收敛，半径减半规则具对数总 oracle 复杂度。
papers.abstract_en: We study Broximal Gradient Descent in a general norm for smooth optimization over a closed convex set. Each update minimizes the linear model over the intersection of the feasible set and a norm ball. Unlike the Euclidean case with suitably restricted radii, the distance to a solution can increase, even when the squared norm is strongly convex. We instead use a comparator inequality and an observable stationarity certificate. For convex objectives, prescribed radii yield value convergence, including escape when the infimum is unattained, and a last-iterate $O(K^{-1/3})$ bound without a distance-bound assumption. A level-set distance bound gives an all-iteration $O(1/K)$ rate with calibrated radii and an asymptotic $O(\log K/K)$ rate with radii using no problem constant. Strong convexity and power growth give explicit faster envelopes and convergence of the iterates. Without convexity, a constrained Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequality gives linear convergence with prescribed radii. An observable radius-halving rule needs a valid smoothness constant but neither the PL modulus nor an initial gap bound; warm starting gives logarithmic total oracle complexity in inverse accuracy. The analysis separates established local-oracle ingredients from the control of level sets, radius calibration, and accuracy-based oracle counts.
